description: This is a FastAPI-based backend API implementation for a repair service platform, including endpoints for user authentication, repair management, catalog data, service center search, and admin analytics. It integrates with Supabase for data storage and enforces role-based access control via JWT and RLS policies.

classes.name: RepairCreateRequest
classes.description: Payload for creating a repair booking.

classes.name: RepairResponse
classes.description: Repair record returned to clients.

classes.name: RepairStatusUpdateRequest
classes.description: Payload to update a repair's status.

classes.name: AdminRepairAnalyticsResponse
classes.description: Admin analytics summary across repairs.

classes.name: AssignTechnicianRequest
classes.description: Admin payload to assign a technician to a repair.

classes.name: BrandResponse
classes.description: Brand record for booking catalog.

classes.name: BrandCreateRequest
classes.description: Admin payload to create a brand.

classes.name: DeviceModelResponse
classes.description: Device model record for booking catalog.

classes.name: DeviceModelCreateRequest
classes.description: Admin payload to create a device model under a brand.

classes.name: IssueResponse
classes.description: Issue record for booking flow (optional catalog).

classes.name: ServiceResponse
classes.description: Service record for booking catalog.

classes.name: ServiceCreateRequest
classes.description: Admin payload to create a service.

classes.name: RepairStatusHistoryResponse
classes.description: Repair status history record.

classes.name: ServiceCenterResponse
classes.description: Service center record for the locator UI.

classes.name: ServiceCenterSearchResponse
